verdict.rationale: Deel Immigration is a SaaS immigration and HR service, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question and the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions an MCP server or any agent-connection endpoint. The only machine-facing signals are an llms.txt file and failed OpenAPI probes, which are adjacent and do not count as an MCP server.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
